title: Listening Drill — Community jam stall — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Community jam stall — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on community jam stall. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Tuesday. The group will now meet on Wednesday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the village green; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is ingredient cards. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow forty-five minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check batch codes before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed stock list so we can offer feedback.
